# Thank you for playing on Goob Station! If you're enjoying your time here, please consider supporting us on Patreon!
Your support helps us keep the servers running, fund development, and continue improving the game.
## Patron Tiers and Rewards
### Assistant ($5/month) - 2x Goob Coin earnings - Priority role queue access - Purple OOC name color - Thanks in the credits in-game - Special Discord role - Access to members-only Discord channel
### Janitor ($10/month) - Custom ghost color - All previous tier benefits
### Station AI ($20/month) - Custom lobby message - All previous tier benefits
### Captain ($50/month) - Round-end shoutout - All previous tier benefits
### Central Command ($100/month) - Our undying love - All previous tier benefits
